{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the distribution of channels
tab_channel = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment'])
print("Cross-tab of channel vs customer segment:\n", tab_channel)

# Check if the groups are comparable in terms of customer_segment
print("\nProportion of loyal customers in each channel:\n", 
      df.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack()['loyal'])"}
